summary: Frontend-only i18n verification for the two new languages FR and FA. Tested language switching via data-testid 'lang-select' across all 5 bottom-nav tabs (Home, Recipes, Your Lab, Learn, Social), Ricette Custodite list + recipe detail, Encyclopedia page, and return to IT. RESULT: bottom nav, Social, Your Lab intro, RTL direction (dir=rtl for fa) and the whole Ricette Custodite flow (list, filters, improver note, ingredients, steps, Partager/Copier/Imprimer) are correctly translated in FR and FA. However the Learn tab CRASHES in both FR and FA, and Home + Your Lab feature grid + Encyclopedia are still English/Italian because ~18 files still contain legacy language helpers that were NOT converted by the codemod.

ui_bugs.issue: CRASH in FR and FA: 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading freeCourses)' -> ErrorBoundary shows 'Oups, quelque chose a plante' / 'اوه، یه مشکلی پیش اومد'. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/data/content.js only defines it/de/en/es and lines 203-204 only add fallbacks for en/es, so content['fr'] and content['fa'] are undefined. Same crash risk in MaestroSaTutto.jsx:52,179,209, Encyclopedia.jsx:7, Mikilab.jsx:13, NewsPage.jsx:9, Beginners.jsx:353, CoursesPanel.jsx:7. IT/EN/ES/DE Learn tab works.

Home page is still ENGLISH in FR and FA because the local helper was not codemodded: `const L = (it_,de_,en_,es_) => ... (lang==="fr"||lang==="fa") ? (en_ ?? it_) : it_`. Untranslated strings observed on Home in FR and FA: 'FLAVOUR OF THE DAY', 'Sourdough, long proof & butter: the king of leavened cakes.', 'MIKILAB / Exclusive Recipes & Operational Consulting / for Pastry, Baking and Pizzeria', 'Access tested recipes, technical sheets and practical strategies to organise your lab, unlocking them through our community challenges.', 'Challenge Engine', 'Unlock recipes by completing challenges. No payment.', 'Baking Craft Glossary', 'Technical terms in plain words', 'Learn by Levels', 'Pass the quizzes: each level counts as a challenge', 'WEEKLY CHALLENGE', 'Challenge yourself and your friends in the themed quiz!', 'Play', 'The heart of MikiLab', 'THE SOUL', 'My Recipes', 'Recipes with my method', 'My Courses', "Michele's online courses (soon)", 'START HERE', 'Your Lab', 'Generate the AI plan, timers, costs, cells & doughs — all in one place.', 'Legal notice & Privacy'. Additionally ITALIAN leaks: 'Il tuo compagno digitale' (Home.jsx:145 hardcoded ternary, shown in both FR and FA) and the rotating hero tagline ('Calcolo dosi, idratazione e costi 🧮' in FR, 'Ti seguo da smartphone e PC 📱💻' / 'Organizzo le tue ricette 📋' in FA).

Your Lab feature grid ('Regarde ce que ca fait' / 'ببین چطور کار می‌کند') is fully ITALIAN in FR and FA (also in ES). Root cause: `const flang = lang === 'de' ? 'de' : lang === 'en' ? 'en' : 'it'` and FEATURES only has it/de/en. Strings: 'Impostazione Macchine', 'Configura impastatrici, celle, frigo e dispositivi', 'Piano settimanale', 'Organizza ricette e quantità per ogni giorno', 'Adatta al forno', 'Gradi e minuti giusti cambiando tipo di forno', 'Costi & Spesa', 'Calcolo costi in € e lista della spesa per fornitori', 'Le Mie Ricette', 'Aggiungi o scansiona: la foto diventa testo modificabile', 'Piano di Produzione con IA', 'Genera produzione, spesa, ordini e ricette in un colpo'.
Label hardcoded to English for fr/fa: `(lang==="en"||lang==="fr"||lang==="fa") ? 'Flavour of the Day'`. Should be 'Saveur du Jour' (FR) and Persian.

In FR the Encyclopedie page shows ITALIAN bodies for every accordion (Poolish, 'Lievito Madre — pane vs panettone', 'Roggen Sauerteig (pasta acida di segale)', 'Backmittel (Miglioratore naturale)', 'Autolisi', 'Incordatura', ... full list) because data/content.js has no fr/fa. Same for the 'Nouveautes du MikiLab' news items on the Recipes tab (Cornetto Bicolore..., Pane Nero al Carbone Vegetale, Pane agli Spinaci, ...).

FA leftovers: breadcrumb/back label 'Ricette' stays Italian in FA (FR correctly shows 'Recettes'); recipe titles 'Pane di Matera IGP', 'Focaccia Barese', 'نان Altamura DOP' not translated in the FA list/detail (FR translates them to 'Pain de Matera', 'Focaccia de Bari', 'Pain d'Altamura DOP'). Add these keys to triTranslations.json for fa.

ui_bugs.component: Legacy language helpers not converted by codemod (18 files)
ui_bugs.issue: These files still map fr/fa to EN (or IT) instead of delegating to mkTri(lang), so every screen they render leaks EN/IT: sections/Home.jsx:222, sections/ScopriMikiLab.jsx:8, sections/SaporiCasa.jsx:47, sections/SimulatoreForno.jsx:14, sections/SmartWeatherBaker.jsx:7, sections/EsuberoZero.jsx:17+18(rL), sections/SosImpastoGuida.jsx:26, sections/CantiereRicetta.jsx:10+20(field), sections/ConvertitoreLieviti.jsx:10, sections/BancaLievito.jsx:9, sections/CalcolatoreStampi.jsx:12, sections/TimeLapseTracker.jsx:11, sections/TrovaFarina.jsx:24+25(uL), sections/AngoloRecupero.jsx:24, sections/Glossario.jsx:29, sections/Shop.jsx:58(pick), components/EULabel.jsx:5, components/SaporeDelGiorno.jsx:24. Also sections/CapoLaboratorio.jsx:57 uses a raw de/en/it ternary.

issues: Persian glyphs render disjointed/unshaped in the serif display font (e.g. header subtitle 'کارگاه نان میکله', card titles, buttons) - the font-display webfont has no Arabic/Persian shaping; add a Persian-capable font (e.g. Vazirmatn/Noto Naskh Arabic) for :lang(fa)
RTL layout itself is correct (document.documentElement.dir === 'rtl'), nav and cards mirror properly
Mixed-language page (French chrome + English body) looks broken to the user until helper L is converted

action_items: CRITICAL: add fr/fa entries (or at minimum `if (!content.fr) content.fr = content.it; if (!content.fa) content.fa = content.it;`) in /app/frontend/src/data/content.js - fixes the Learn tab crash (freeCourses undefined) and prevents the same crash on Encyclopedia/News/MaestroSaTutto/Mikilab pages
Convert the 18 remaining local language helpers (L/rL/uL/field/pick/label listed above) to mkTri(lang) - especially sections/Home.jsx:222 and the hardcoded ternary at Home.jsx:145
Extend PaywallGate FEATURES + flang to fr/fa (and es) so the Your Lab feature grid is not Italian
Fix components/SaporeDelGiorno.jsx label for fr/fa ('Saveur du Jour' + Persian)
Add missing FA map entries: 'Ricette' (breadcrumb), 'Pane di Matera IGP', 'Focaccia Barese', 'Pane di Altamura DOP', plus the Home strings once L is converted
Add a Persian-capable webfont for lang=fa to fix glyph shaping
critical_code_review_comments: data/content.js only has it/de/en/es and its safety fallbacks cover only en/es - any new SUPPORTED language immediately crashes 6 consumers that do content[lang].X without a guard. Use `content[lang] || content.it` at every consumer, or build the object from SUPPORTED.

The codemod matched only helpers named tri*, leaving 18 helpers named L/rL/uL/field/pick that hardcode language branches. A lint rule banning `lang === "en" ?` outside i18n/ would prevent regressions.
PaywallGate hardcodes lang buckets (de/en/it) duplicating the fallback logic already in mkTri - reuse mkTri instead.

success_rate.frontend: 60% - 4/5 tabs render in FR/FA, Learn tab crashes, Home & Your Lab grid untranslated

context_for_next_testing_agent: Language switch: page.select_option('[data-testid="lang-select"]', 'fr'|'fa'). Verified OK in FR+FA: bottom nav labels (Accueil/Recettes/Ton Laboratoire/Apprendre/Reseaux sociaux; خانه/دستورها/کارگاه شما/آموزش/شبکه‌های اجتماعی), dir=rtl for fa, Social tab, Your Lab intro copy, and full Ricette Custodite flow ([data-testid=ricette-custodite-band] -> custodite-open-<id>) incl. improver note, ingredients ('Ameliorant Naturel MikiLab' / 'بهبوددهنده طبیعی MikiLab'), steps and Partager/Copier/Imprimer buttons. Switching back to IT is clean (no 'undefined'). Still failing: Learn tab crash (content.fr/fa missing), Home body English, Your Lab feature grid Italian, Encyclopedia Italian. Console also shows 4x 401 on unauthenticated API calls at load (pre-existing, harmless).
rca_of_the_issue: Two independent root causes: (1) /app/frontend/src/data/content.js exposes translations keyed by language with runtime fallbacks only for en/es (lines 203-204); consumers dereference content[lang] directly, so fr/fa yield undefined -> Beginners.jsx:353 throws on .freeCourses and the ErrorBoundary replaces the Learn tab. (2) The i18n codemod that replaced local tri helpers with mkTri(lang) did not match helpers named L/rL/uL/field/pick/label; those 18 files still branch `(lang === 'fr' || lang === 'fa') ? en : it`, so FR/FA fall back to English/Italian on Home, Glossario, Shop, EULabel, SaporeDelGiorno and most Your Lab tools. PaywallGate additionally has its own de/en/it bucket.
